verdict.rationale: The first-party manual says SSH keys can reside on the Secure Enclave, protected by Face ID or Touch ID, which is exactly the hardware-backed, biometric-protected storage the story asks for. It also documents generating or importing private keys attached to an Identity. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, and in-depth documentation of the enclave key workflow (key types supported, setup steps, whether keys are non-exportable).
